steps.message: Execute: adb shell "service call clipboard --help; echo '---'; service call clipboard 1; echo '---'; service call clipboard 2; echo '---'; service call clipboard 3; echo '---'; dumpsys clipboard | head -n 40"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "service call clipboard --help; echo '---'; service call clipboard 1; echo '---'; service call clipboard 2; echo '---'; service call clipboard 3; echo '---'; dumpsys clipboard | head -n 40""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "which clipboard || true; which clip || true; which termux-clipboard-set || true; ls /system/bin | grep -i clip || true; ls /system/xbin | grep -i clip || true; cmd activity help | grep -i clip || true"
